title: lilium washingtonianum var. rubescens
intro: Lilium washingtonianum var. rubescens, commonly known as the Washington lily, is a variety of the Washington lily plant that belongs to the lily family (Liliaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lilium washingtonianum var. rubescens include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, which helps to relieve respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
